name: Butter Chicken with Spinach, Cilantro & Baked Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head cauliflower
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro
1 (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Season cauliflower rice with salt and pepper. Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over top.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower rice halfway through, until tender and golden, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the onion is done, add chicken to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 5-6 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic, along with tomato paste, water, garam masala, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tbsp tomato paste
4 tsp garam masala
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken is done, add spice paste to the skillet and stir to coat. Add broth and cream, then stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until curry has thickened, 10-12 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
8 fl oz (1 cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: When the curry has thickened, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and butter chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
